test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 20 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six letters A, B, C, P, Q and R are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Find the letter on the face opposite to A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88faf9176f84046e8b9ebb920a481e43dd7049e75ac8b3a2c2aec1bcc1e25a50.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of 'A', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/344ac6a9f44cd658f59ee6d5430978cefcdfc05246e119bf88a73ce644ee60d1.png] 

From both dices, Q is common and on the same surface. So, all remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

P is opposite to Q.

R is opposite to C.

So, B will be opposite to A.

Hence, the correct answer is "B".
